left.title: Yehaset Danynet
left.description: This mezmur reflects on the unjust judgment and suffering of Jesus Christ, emphasizing His innocence and the cruelty He endured. It describes how He was falsely accused, insulted, and condemned despite giving life and healing to others. The chant highlights human ignorance and hardness of heart, showing how people repaid His love and mercy with hatred and violence. It calls listeners to reflect on Christ’s humility, sacrifice, and compassion, encouraging repentance and deeper appreciation of His suffering for humanity’s salvation.

right.title: Alfana Omega
right.description:
Original Song: Alfa Ena Omega
Singer: Liqe Mezemeran Kinetibeb Weldekirkos

Alpha and Omega by all you are worshipped 
In the hands of traitors you were brought for verdict 

They pushed and abused you they wanted to subdue 
While inflicting torment Christ they said mocking you
Your call was holiness their response was disdain
Adam’s children were saved as you carried our pain 

Your righteous holy hands with chains they were bounded
They were blinded to the forgiveness you granted
Always omnipresent from the seas to the skies
But they covered your face your glory they despised

They stood you for judgment in the court of Pilate 
They handed you over the uproaring riots 
Annas, Caiaphas too sought your condemnation
They sent you to Herod with a proclamation

Your flesh covered in blood from beatings you endured
They added to that pain suffering they assured
They nailed you to the cross my Lord the Prince of Peace 
They put a crown of thorns on you the King of Kings

They pierced you on your side wounded their medicine
With your bound outstretched hands you carried our sins
All the soldiers mocked you as you hanged on the tree
I must never forget the price you paid for me

Website: https://www.ahadustudios.com/ 

Instagram: https://instagram.com/ahadu.studios

Tiktok: https://tiktok.com/@ahadu.studios

Facebook: https://facebook.com/ahadustudios

አማን በአማን /2/
አማኑኤል ተመስገን
ለዚህ ፍቅርህ ምን ልክፈልህ
ድብቁን ኃጢአት አንተ ብትገልጸው
ይቅር ብለኧኝ ባትሸፋፍነው
እንደ ሰው በቀል ቢኖርህ ጌታ
የኔስ ኃጢአት የለውም ቦታ
/አዝ \=====
በየ ደቂቃው ኃጢአት ስሰራ
ስሰርቅ ሰበድል አንተን ሳልፈራ
አንተ ግን ፊትህ ምንም ቢቀየም
በቁጣ በትር አልገረፍከኝም
/አዝ \=====
ምህረትን ልከህ አድነኝ ዛሬ
ታክቶኛልና በኃጢአት መኖሬ
ዓለም በኃጢአት እየሳበችኝ
በጽድቅ በደስታ መኖር አቃተኝ
/አዝ \=====
የኃጠአት ጉዞ ጣፋጭ ቢመስልም
ውጤቱ መሮ ፍጹም አይጥምም
እንደ በደሌ ስላልከፈልከኝ
ተመስገን እንጂ ሌላ ምን አለኝ

right.title: Praise And Glory
right.description: This mezmur is a powerful expression of praise and worship to God, acknowledging His greatness as Creator of heaven and earth. It highlights His mighty works, mercy, and faithfulness, emphasizing that all creation—both in heaven and on earth—glorifies Him. The chant calls believers to join the angels and the saints in exalting God's name, recognizing His saving power, compassion, and provision. It encourages a life centered on worship, gratitude, and reverence for God’s eternal glory.

right.title: Imebete Yeamlak Inat
right.description: This mezmur is a heartfelt praise to the Virgin Mary, honoring her as the Mother of God and the Queen of heaven and earth. It expresses a desire to continually glorify her and her Son, recognizing her humility, purity, and chosen role as the dwelling place of God. The chant also reflects deep reliance on her intercession, asking her to guide and protect believers through trials and lead them safely through spiritual struggles. It emphasizes devotion, humility, and trust in her motherly care.

right.title: Imebete Yeamlak Inat
right.description:
Original Song: Emebete Ye-Amlak Enat
Original Singer: Liqe Mezemeran Tewodros Yosef

Mother of God Virgin Mary
Day and night I will sing to thee
Your blessed son I'll glorify
Worship is due to The Most High
           
My heart it will arise tuned for praise I will sing
Through my humility I give my offering 
Zion you are near me Abraham's holy tent
Mother of shining light it’s you I lean against

O Green Meadow of Peace the one He had chosen
Ark of the covenant you're Isaiah's virgin
Queen of heaven and Earth standing on the Lord's right
Honor is due to her we will sing day and night

Dearest Virgin Mary the mother of us all
With your intercession save me so I don't fall
Help me cross through the flames keep me on the right path
Death and defeat will cease since I have you at last

right.lyrics_amharic:

ሰምቼ የቃልህን ትምህርት
ሆኛለሁ ምስክር ለአዳኝነትህ
ሥጋን ተዋሕደህ ለኛ መገለጥህ/2/
አዝ \======
ተከተልኩ ሁሉን ነገር ንቄ
መድሃኒት መሆንክን አወቄ
ከመልካሟ ቤትህ ተጠልያለሁ
የእጅህን በረከት ካንተ እጠግባለሁ/2/
አዝ \======
እርፍ ይዤ ላላርስ ወደ ኃላ
እያየሁ መረቤን ስትሞላ
እመካብሃለሁ ባንተ መድኅኜ
አምላኬ ነህና የምትራራ ለኔ
አባቴ ነህና የምታስብ ለእኔ
አዝ \======
ቸርነት ምህረት ከበዛልኝ
ለስምህ ውዳሴ ቅኔ አለኝ
ክብሬና ሞገሴ አንተ ነህ ጌታ
ተመስገን ተመስገን ጠዋትና ማታ /2/

right.title: Kewegene Gar
right.lyrics_amharic:
ከወገኔ ጋራ እዘምራለሁ
በደስታ በሐሴት ስሙን እጠራለሁ
ምግብና መጠጤ አምላኬ ነውና
ዘወትር አቀርባለሁ ለጌታ ምስጋና
ህዝቡ ተሰብስቦ በቤተ ክርስቲያን
ሲዘምር ደስ ይላል በአንድነት ሆነን
በረከት ይሞላል ዝማሬው ይገርማል
ከእጣኑ ጋር ወደ ላይ ይወጣል
ቀሳውስቱ ሌሊት ማህሌት ሲያቀርቡ
ከመላእክቱ ጋር ወረብ ሲወርቡ
ብርሃኑን ለብሰን በደስታ ስንዘምር
ትዝታው ልዩ ነው ህሊና ሲሰውር
ራዕይ ነውና ኑና ተመልከቱ
ሰዎች ሲዘምሩ እንደ መላእክቱ
የጽጌው ማህሌት የትንሳኤው ደስታ
ልዩ ዝማሬ ነው እንዳይመስለን ተርታ
right.lyrics_transliteration:
Kewegene gara izemralehu
Bedesta behaset simun iteralehu
Migbina metete amlake newna
Zewetir aqerbalehu legeta misgana
Hizbu tesebsibo bebete kirsitiyan
Sizemr des yilal beandinet honen
Bereket yimolal zimarew yigermal
Keitanu gar wede lay yiwetal
Qesawsitu lelit mahlet siyaqerbu
Kemelaiktu gar wereb siwerbu
Birhanun lebsen bedesta sinzemr
Tiztaw liyu new hilina sisewr
Raiy newna nuna temelketu
Sewoch sizemru inde melaiktu
Yetsgew mahlet yetnisaew desta
Liyu zimare new indaymeslen terta
